note: Pediatric portrait scale + memorable accessory per case. Scene lock: 16:9 ED baseplate ~38° foot-of-bed (never bird-eye).

temperamentCharacterMaps.use: Post-ictal / AMS pediatric temperament — eyes up, confused affect

accessoryRule: Every pediatric portrait includes ONE dignified memorable accessory or comfort object — on the bedside table, at the pillow, or worn. Makes the case stick in memory. Not clutter; never blocks IV/monitor zones; no standing extra people.

accessoryTemplates.label: Toy bed on bedside table
accessoryTemplates.prompt: miniature toy doll bed or small wooden bed on the bedside table — comfort object that came to the hospital with the child

accessoryTemplates.label: Handmade wire-frame glasses
accessoryTemplates.prompt: child wearing creative handmade wire-and-wood glasses (dignified, not costume parody) — memorable clinic accessory

accessoryTemplates.label: Chewing-gum bubble
accessoryTemplates.prompt: small white chewing-gum bubble at lips — playful but calm child, memorable portrait detail

accessoryTemplates.label: Patterned knit hat
accessoryTemplates.prompt: colorful patterned knit hat or headwrap — cultural dignity, memorable silhouette

accessoryTemplates.label: Small stuffed animal
accessoryTemplates.prompt: small worn stuffed animal on pillow or held loosely in one hand — comfort object

054.label: term newborn
054.prompt: term newborn infant, jaundiced skin, swaddled or gown, proportional neonate on ED warmer
054.memorableAccessory: soft receiving blanket folded at bedside — parent comfort item

089.label: school-age child
089.prompt: school-age child approximately 6 years old, smaller body proportions than adult, fully clothed hospital gown, subtle non-graphic facial erythema for clinical training (no gore, no nudity), frightened but stable
089.memorableAccessory: small stuffed animal on the bedside table

143.label: term newborn
143.prompt: term newborn infant, lethargic, jaundiced sclera and skin, supine on ED stretcher — not sitting up, neonate proportions
143.memorableAccessory: soft knit blanket corner visible at pillow — parent brought it

181.label: school-age boy
181.prompt: school-age boy approximately 8 years old, child body proportions, pediatric hospital gown, tired from poor sleep, supine on ED stretcher
181.memorableAccessory: miniature toy doll bed on the wooden bedside table — his comfort object that came to the hospital with him; life is beautiful, dignified
181.ethnicityCue: memorable unique child face — warm natural skin tones, dignified documentary portrait energy

121.label: school-age boy
121.prompt: school-age boy approximately 7 years old, Black child, natural dignified face, pediatric hospital gown, weak tired affect from poor feeding, supine on ED resuscitation stretcher — Steve-approved case 121 portrait
121.memorableAccessory: small comfort item on bedside table or pillow — blanket or worn toy, never blocking monitor or IV zones
121.ethnicityCue: warm natural skin tones, memorable unique child face — approved Poor Feeding pediatric reference
